entities.name: Cedric Errol Carr
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Cedric Errol Carr was a New Zealand botanist, specialising in orchids. At the age of seven he went to England with his family but from January 1913 until 1931, apart from military service from 1916 to 1918, he worked on rubber plantations in Malaya.
